summary.text: Jodi Habush Sinykin is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 8, based in Whitefish Bay, elected to the Senate in 2024.
She is an environmental attorney who serves on the Committee on Natural Resources, Veteran and Military Affairs and the Committee on Financial Institutions and Sporting Heritage.

paragraphs.text: Habush Sinykin was born in Fox Point, Wisconsin, is married to Dan Sinykin, and has four children.
She graduated from Nicolet High School in 1985, from the University of Michigan in 1989 and from Harvard Law School in 1992.
The Legislature's page describes her as an environmental attorney specializing in water resources and wildlife conservation and a co-owner of a Wisconsin textile manufacturing business since 1995.

Her listed work includes a federal judicial clerkship with Judge Charles P. Kocoras in 1992-93, trial work and partnership at Habush, Habush & Rottier from 1995 to 2003, Of Counsel work at Midwest Environmental Advocates from 2003 to 2018, and an adjunct professorship at the UW-Milwaukee School of Freshwater Sciences from 2014 to 2020.
She received the Wisconsin Humane Society's George Dalton Award in 2012, the Wisconsin Sierra Club Merit Award in 2021 and the Democratic Party of Milwaukee County Democrat of the Year Award in 2025.
